SELECT
    hospital_name,
    hospital_address,
    hospital_contact,
    hospital_code,
    hospital_type,
    facility_type,
    state_name,
    district_name,
    TRY_CAST(entry_date_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_updated_at,
    components_raw,
    ingested_at
FROM "blood_warehouse"."bronze"."raw_inventory"
WHERE hospital_name IS NOT NULL
  AND state_name IS NOT NULL

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        scraped_at,
        hospital_code,
        TRIM(hospital_name) AS hospital_name,
        TRIM(state_name) AS state_name,
        TRIM(district_name) AS district_name,
        TRY_CAST(entry_date_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS source_updated_at,
        CAST(components_raw AS JSON) AS comp_json
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."bronze"."raw_inventory"
    WHERE components_raw IS NOT NULL
      AND hospital_code IS NOT NULL
      AND LENGTH(components_raw) > 5
),

component_keys AS (
    SELECT 
        run_id,
        scraped_at,
        hospital_code,
        hospital_name,
        state_name,
        district_name,
        source_updated_at,
        comp_json,
        UNNEST(json_keys(comp_json)) AS component_name
    FROM base
),

avail_strings AS (
    SELECT 
        run_id,
        scraped_at,
        hospital_code,
        hospital_name,
        state_name,
        district_name,
        source_updated_at,
        component_name,
        (comp_json -> component_name) ->> 'available_WithQty' AS avail_str
    FROM component_keys
),

pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        run_id,
        scraped_at,
        hospital_code,
        hospital_name,
        state_name,
        district_name,
        source_updated_at,
        component_name,
        UNNEST(string_split(avail_str, ',')) AS pair
    FROM avail_strings
    WHERE avail_str IS NOT NULL 
      AND TRIM(avail_str) != ''
)

SELECT 
    run_id,
    scraped_at,
    hospital_code,
    hospital_name,
    state_name,
    district_name,
    TRIM(component_name) AS component_name,
    
CASE
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%OH+%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%OHPOS%' 
      OR UPPER(string_split(pair, ':')[1]) LIKE '%BOMBAY%OH+%' THEN 'Bombay (Oh+)'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%OH-%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%OHNEG%' 
      OR UPPER(string_split(pair, ':')[1]) LIKE '%BOMBAY%OH-%' THEN 'Bombay (Oh-)'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%OH%' 
      OR UPPER(string_split(pair, ':')[1]) LIKE '%BOMBAY%' THEN 'Bombay (Oh+)'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'AB+%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%AB+VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%ABPOS%' THEN 'AB+'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'AB-%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%AB-VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%ABNEG%' THEN 'AB-'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'A+%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%A+VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%APOS%' THEN 'A+'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'A-%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%A-VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%ANEG%' THEN 'A-'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'B+%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%B+VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%BPOS%' THEN 'B+'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'B-%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%B-VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%BNEG%' THEN 'B-'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'O+%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%O+VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%OPOS%' THEN 'O+'
    WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE 'O-%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%O-VE%' 
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(string_split(pair, ':')[1], ' ', '')) LIKE '%ONEG%' THEN 'O-'
    ELSE TRIM(string_split(pair, ':')[1])
END
 AS blood_group,
    GREATEST(0, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(TRIM(string_split(pair, ':')[2]) AS INTEGER), 0)) AS units,
    source_updated_at
FROM pairs
WHERE pair LIKE '%:%'
  AND TRIM(string_split(pair, ':')[1]) != ''

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        scraped_at,
        hospital_code,
        TRIM(hospital_name) AS hospital_name,
        TRIM(hospital_address) AS hospital_address,
        TRIM(hospital_contact) AS hospital_contact,
        TRIM(hospital_type) AS hospital_type,
        TRIM(facility_type) AS facility_type,
        TRIM(state_name) AS state_name,
        TRIM(district_name) AS district_name,
        TRY_CAST(entry_date_raw AS TIMESTAMP) AS source_updated_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY hospital_code
            ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, TRY_CAST(entry_date_raw AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."bronze"."raw_inventory"
    WHERE hospital_code IS NOT NULL
      AND hospital_name IS NOT NULL
      AND state_name IS NOT NULL
)

/*
================================================================================
MART STOCK CHANGE (7-Day Consumption & Days-of-Cover)
================================================================================
Absolute Rule: ZERO fake data.
This model strictly evaluates whether >= 7 distinct real snapshot dates exist
in the lakehouse. If fewer than 7 real snapshot dates exist, it yields an honest
empty dataset rather than extrapolating or fabricating trend rates.
================================================================================
*/

WITH date_check AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT snapshot_date) AS distinct_dates_count
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."fct_stock_snapshot"
),

snapshots_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.hospital_code,
        s.hospital_name,
        s.state_name,
        s.district_name,
        s.component_name,
        s.blood_group,
        s.units,
        s.snapshot_date,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC) AS date_rank_desc
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."fct_stock_snapshot" s
    -- Only execute calculations if at least 7 distinct real snapshot dates exist
    WHERE (SELECT distinct_dates_count FROM date_check) >= 7
),

latest_vs_7d AS (
    SELECT
        curr.hospital_code,
        curr.hospital_name,
        curr.state_name,
        curr.district_name,
        curr.component_name,
        curr.blood_group,
        curr.units AS current_units,
        prev.units AS units_7d_ago,
        (curr.units - prev.units) AS delta_7d,
        GREATEST(0.0, (prev.units - curr.units) / 7.0) AS est_daily_consumption_rate
    FROM (SELECT * FROM snapshots_ranked WHERE date_rank_desc = 1) curr
    INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM snapshots_ranked WHERE date_rank_desc = 7) prev
      ON curr.hospital_code = prev.hospital_code
     AND curr.component_name = prev.component_name
     AND curr.blood_group = prev.blood_group
)

SELECT
    hospital_code,
    hospital_name,
    state_name,
    district_name,
    component_name,
    blood_group,
    current_units,
    units_7d_ago,
    delta_7d,
    ROUND(est_daily_consumption_rate, 2) AS daily_consumption_rate,
    CASE 
        WHEN est_daily_consumption_rate > 0 THEN ROUND(current_units / est_daily_consumption_rate, 1)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS days_of_cover_estimate
FROM latest_vs_7d

WITH ranked AS (

)

base_data AS (

        b.state_name,
        b.district_name,
        b.source_updated_at AS last_updated_at,

    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_silver"."stg_blood_banks" b
    LEFT JOIN facility_units u ON b.hospital_code = u.hospital_code

SELECT

    state_name,
    district_name,
    last_updated_at,
    days_since_last_update,
    total_units,
    CASE
        WHEN days_since_last_update > 30 THEN 'CRITICALLY STALE (>30 days)'
        WHEN days_since_last_update > 7 THEN 'OUTDATED (>7 days)'
        ELSE 'CURRENT'
    END AS data_freshness_status,
    CASE
        WHEN total_units = 0 THEN 'CRITICAL DEPLETION (0 Units)'
        WHEN total_units <= 5 THEN 'MODERATE DEFICIT REPORTED'
        ELSE 'NORMAL / NO REPORT'
    END AS stock_alert_level
FROM base_data

/*
================================================================================
MART RELIABILITY SCORE FORMULA (0 - 100 Points)
================================================================================
1. Freshness Score (Max 50 Points):
   - Last updated within 24 hours (<= 1 day): 50 pts
   - Last updated within 7 days (2 to 7 days): 35 pts
   - Last updated within 30 days (8 to 30 days): 15 pts
   - Critically stale (> 30 days or NULL): 0 pts

2. Valid Contact Score (Max 25 Points):
   - Contains phone number (matches digits >= 8): 25 pts
   - Has street address but unverified phone: 10 pts
   - Missing both contact and address: 0 pts

3. Component Completeness Score (Max 25 Points):
   - Tracks >= 3 distinct blood components (PRBC, Platelets, FFP, etc.): 25 pts
   - Tracks 1 or 2 blood components: 15 pts
   - No components reported: 0 pts
================================================================================
*/

WITH facility_components AS (
    SELECT
        hospital_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT component_name) AS distinct_components_count,
        SUM(units) AS total_units_in_stock
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."fct_stock_current"
    GROUP BY hospital_code
),

base_facilities AS (
    SELECT
        b.hospital_code,
        b.hospital_name,
        b.hospital_type,
        b.facility_type,
        b.state_name,
        b.district_name,
        b.hospital_contact,
        b.hospital_address,
        b.source_updated_at,
        DATE_DIFF('day', b.source_updated_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS days_since_update,
        COALESCE(c.distinct_components_count, 0) AS distinct_components_count,
        COALESCE(c.total_units_in_stock, 0) AS total_units_in_stock
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."dim_blood_banks" b
    LEFT JOIN facility_components c ON b.hospital_code = c.hospital_code
),

scored AS (
    SELECT
        hospital_code,
        hospital_name,
        hospital_type,
        facility_type,
        state_name,
        district_name,
        hospital_contact,
        hospital_address,
        source_updated_at,
        days_since_update,
        distinct_components_count,
        total_units_in_stock,
        -- 1. Freshness Points (0-50)
        CASE
            WHEN days_since_update <= 1 THEN 50
            WHEN days_since_update <= 7 THEN 35
            WHEN days_since_update <= 30 THEN 15
            ELSE 0
        END AS freshness_points,
        -- 2. Contact Points (0-25)
        CASE
            WHEN hospital_contact LIKE '%Phone%' OR regexp_matches(hospital_contact, '[0-9]{8,}') THEN 25
            WHEN hospital_address IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(hospital_address) > 10 THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END AS contact_points,
        -- 3. Component Completeness Points (0-25)
        CASE
            WHEN distinct_components_count >= 3 THEN 25
            WHEN distinct_components_count >= 1 THEN 15
            ELSE 0
        END AS completeness_points
    FROM base_facilities
)

SELECT
    hospital_code,
    hospital_name,
    hospital_type,
    facility_type,
    state_name,
    district_name,
    hospital_contact,
    hospital_address,
    source_updated_at,
    days_since_update,
    distinct_components_count,
    total_units_in_stock,
    freshness_points,
    contact_points,
    completeness_points,
    (freshness_points + contact_points + completeness_points) AS reliability_score,
    CASE
        WHEN (freshness_points + contact_points + completeness_points) >= 75 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN (freshness_points + contact_points + completeness_points) >= 50 THEN 'MODERATE'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS reliability_tier
FROM scored

with all_values as (

    select
        reliability_tier as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."mart_reliability_score"
    group by reliability_tier

/*
================================================================================
MART RARE BLOOD AVAILABILITY
================================================================================
Tracks life-critical rare blood phenotypes:
1. Bombay Blood Group (Oh+ / Oh-)
2. Rh-Negative Phenotypes (O-, A-, B-, AB-)
Includes direct facility contact info and location for emergency dispatch.
================================================================================
*/

WITH rare_stock AS (
    SELECT
        s.hospital_code,
        s.component_name,
        s.blood_group,
        s.units,
        s.source_updated_at,
        s.last_synced_at
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."fct_stock_current" s
    WHERE s.blood_group IN (
        'Bombay (Oh+)',
        'Bombay (Oh-)',
        'O-',
        'A-',
        'B-',
        'AB-'
    )
      AND s.units > 0
)

SELECT
    r.hospital_code,
    b.hospital_name,
    b.hospital_type,
    b.state_name,
    b.district_name,
    b.hospital_contact,
    b.hospital_address,
    r.component_name,
    r.blood_group,
    r.units,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.blood_group LIKE 'Bombay%' THEN 'ULTRA_RARE_BOMBAY'
        ELSE 'RH_NEGATIVE'
    END AS rarity_tier,
    r.source_updated_at,
    r.last_synced_at
FROM rare_stock r
JOIN "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."dim_blood_banks" b ON r.hospital_code = b.hospital_code
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN r.blood_group LIKE 'Bombay%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    r.units DESC

WITH current_stock AS (
    SELECT
        state_name,
        district_name,
        component_name,
        blood_group,
        hospital_code,
        units
    FROM "blood_warehouse"."main_gold"."fct_stock_current"
),

aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        state_name,
        district_name,
        component_name,
        blood_group,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hospital_code) AS total_reporting_banks,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN units > 0 THEN hospital_code END) AS stocked_banks,
        SUM(units) AS total_units,
        MIN(units) AS min_facility_units,
        MAX(units) AS max_facility_units
    FROM current_stock
    GROUP BY state_name, district_name, component_name, blood_group
)

SELECT
    state_name,
    district_name,
    component_name,
    blood_group,
    total_reporting_banks,
    stocked_banks,
    total_units,
    min_facility_units,
    max_facility_units,
    CASE 
        WHEN total_units = 0 THEN 'CRITICAL_DEPLETION'
        WHEN total_units <= 5 THEN 'HIGH_SHORTAGE'
        WHEN total_units <= 15 THEN 'MODERATE_SHORTAGE'
        ELSE 'ADEQUATE'
    END AS shortage_status
FROM aggregated
